This is obvious, right? But this is considered revolutionary in Washington. Of course, no foreign leader should be in the Situation Room, directing us who to attack. Again, @RoKhanna leads.


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

Let's start with this pledge. 

The next Democratic President will never have the Israeli PM in the Situation Room.

Trump having Netanyahu there before launching an immoral and illegal war is a betrayal of the American people.





— https://nitter.net/RoKhanna/status/204206671628539

He is saying we are going to do this war, with or without you. I vote without. And there is no rational argument for helping Israel in a war THEY ARE CHOOSING. 

Let's come home, not spend another dollar on Israel and let them deal with the problems they are choosing to create.

Netanyahu just said the war is not over for them and that they are ready for a renewal of the conflict. He said, "Our finger is on the trigger." Isn't it always? And, "Iran is weaker than ever and Israel is stronger than ever." Great, then you got this, dog. You don't need us.
This is what happens when you pretend that there's a deal, when there was no deal!

Iran is saying we have to pay reparations, take out our bases from the Gulf and get Israel to stop attacking their neighbors. Media is reporting it like they agreed to our terms. That's not remotely true. And they're acting like we agreed to their terms, which also isn't true.

Trump unilaterally declared a ceasefire without negotiating what was in it. Iran then declared victory and said US had accepted their 10 Point Plan, which isn't true. So, now when Israel continues to bomb Lebanon, Iran says that's a violation - and have closed the Strait again.

Midterms are going to be much worse for Republicans than people realize. Yes, Democrat's polling  numbers still suck, even as GOP is melting down. But the polls are not taking into account people staying home. America First voters aren't going to be excited to vote for this mess.
Prediction: Mainstream media will start grumbling hard about this ceasefire. If Israel doesn’t want it, our national media will start attacking it. They’ll try to embarrass Trump back into the war.
There is approximately a zero percent chance Israel will abide by a ceasefire.

Iran is declaring they won and America will accept their 10 Point Plan, which includes removing all of our bases in the Gulf, pay reparations to Iran and getting Israel to stop attacking their neighbors. We didn't agree to those things, so I don't know what happens in two weeks.

I think the effect will be similar if they put in ground troops. Price of oil has already gone up 90% in some countries. This has the chance to destroy the whole world economy. All to make Israel happy. This is insane. So, when you are at the pump, remember who did this to you.

I think tomorrow is going to be a disastrous turning point for us. This war never made any sense, but going in deeper is going to be a historic mistake. If we bomb power plants and Iran does likewise, the price of oil will skyrocket. The economic effects will be catastrophic.

Trump might be doing misdirection. That instead of bombing their power plants, he'll put in ground troops. Just because you didn't kill everyone in Iran, doesn't mean it's a good thing to put in ground troops. No one should give him credit for clearing that bar. No ground troops!

Saying "a whole civilization die tonight" is not a threat of a genocide, it's threat of a holocaust. Genocide is killing a race or religion, in whole or in part, what happened in Gaza. Holocaust is killing a whole race or civilization. Even the threat is a moral stain on America.

I’m the last person to rub it in to people who voted for Trump. I’ve been saying from day one that we should be open to our fellow citizens who were misled by him. But today you can see why I voted for three corporate Democrats I can’t stand over him. He has always been a madman.

I'm an atheist now, but Tucker comes to the same logical conclusions on these topics through his faith. I grew up in a Turkish, Muslim family. And no matter what our actual beliefs were (very secular in our case), national media smeared us as terrorists. I'll take this ally!

People tell me I have to hate @TuckerCarlson, but no one in mainstream media was ever this decent to us: "No president should mock Islam." They all smeared Muslims to help Israel. Am I supposed to disagree with this? "We are not a theocracy. And God willing, we never will be."

This guy is unbelievable. I say Trump's advisors screwed him over and that they work for a different country. And his response is - who cares? So, you don't care if the president's advisors work for a different country and screwed over our country? From Levin, sounds about right.


Mark R. Levin (@marklevinshow)

Who cares. Deport.



— https://nitter.net/marklevinshow/status/2041305900174999719#m

Here is Israeli Ambassador to UN admitting Israel are the terrorists. They’re targeting civilians on purpose. If an Arab country said this, everyone in legacy media would call them terrorists. Guaranteed that hacks like @jaketapper will make excuses for it when Israel does it.


Power to the People ☭🕊 (@ProudSocialist)

Israel's Ambassador to the UN:

"We have the legitimacy to target civilian targets in Iran.”

There it is folks…

Israel openly and brazenly admitting that they target civilians,

Mainstream media is having a mask off moment in their desperate attempt to cover up Israel's war crimes. Almost no coverage of Israel's horrific invasion of Lebanon. No coverage of their constant attacks on civilian targets. Hard to call Israel's Muslim neighbors terrorists when Israel is blatantly doing far worse.

Now @jaketapper is comically trying to brand the excellent coverage of @DropSiteNews as Iranian propaganda. Jake, just because you do Israeli propaganda every day, doesn't mean that
